column9: Strong review-worthy remote L&D/technical enablement role. Good fit for technical learning design, LMS administration/reporting, stakeholder partnership, onboarding, reusable job aids/toolkits, facilitation, accessibility, and healthcare technology adjacency. Main cautions: role is dedicated to Technology organization and asks for agile/product-delivery practice enablement; Mark has Agile ID team leadership and technical-learning migration experience but not direct software delivery enablement ownership. Remote salary range $98K-$155K is viable if negotiated above minimum.
